title: Tensor transport along a bijective ring map
statement: Let R,S,B be commutative rings, k:R→S a bijective ring homomorphism, psi:S→B a ring homomorphism, M an R-module and N an S-module. If c:M≃+N satisfies c(r m)=k(r)c(m), then there exists a B-linear isomorphism beta:B tensor_(R,psi k) M≅B tensor_(S,psi) N taking b tensor m to b tensor c(m). All tensor products and scalar extensions use Mathlib ModuleCat.extendScalars. No flatness or nonzero-ring assumption is needed.

proof.text: Use RingEquiv.ofBijective k hk. The identity additive equivalence on B is semilinear from the R-action through psi composed with k to the S-action through psi. The supplied c is semilinear by hc. Mathlib TensorProduct.congr gives a semilinear tensor equivalence with the required pure-tensor formula. Upgrade its additive equivalence to a B-linear equivalence: tensor induction reduces B-linearity to zero, pure tensors (multiplication in B), and sums. Convert the B-linear equivalence with LinearEquiv.toModuleIso. The formula on pure tensors is definitional. This constructs the forward and inverse tensor maps; no flatness is used.

theorem exists_inverseImage_stalk_scalar_transport_beta
    {R S B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing B]
    (k : R →+* S) (hk : Function.Bijective k) (ψ : S →+* B)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (N : ModuleCat.{u} S)
    (c : M ≃+ N) (hc : ∀ (r : R) (m : M), c (r • m) = k r • c m) :
    ∃ β : (ModuleCat.extendScalars (ψ.comp k)).obj M ≅
        (ModuleCat.extendScalars ψ).obj N,
      ∀ (b : B) (m : M), β.hom (b ⊗ₜ[_, ψ.comp k] m) =
        b ⊗ₜ[_, ψ] c m
